scenes.say: Before time. Before light. There was only God. And this... is the greatest story ever told.

scenes.title: CREATION
scenes.say: Chapter one. Creation. God spoke, and light tore through the darkness. Stars ignited. Oceans roared. And from the dust, he formed humanity in his own image. But in a garden, a single choice broke the world. The waters rose, and only Noah's ark endured.

scenes.title: THE PROMISE
scenes.say: Chapter two. The promise. Under a sky of countless stars, God made a vow to one man, Abraham. Your descendants will outnumber these stars. From his son Isaac came Jacob, and from Jacob, twelve tribes. And a boy named Joseph, sold as a slave, would rise to rule Egypt.

scenes.title: EXODUS
scenes.say: Chapter three. Exodus. Four hundred years of chains. Then Moses stood before Pharaoh. Let my people go. Ten plagues fell. And at the edge of the sea, with an army behind them, the waters split apart. On a burning mountain, God carved his law in stone.

scenes.title: THE PROMISED LAND
scenes.say: Chapter four. The promised land. Joshua led them across the Jordan. Trumpets sounded, the people shouted, and the walls of Jericho came crashing down. Then came the judges. Deborah. Gideon. Samson, whose strength shook a temple.

scenes.title: THE KING
scenes.say: Chapter five. The king. A shepherd boy. A giant. A single stone. David brought down Goliath, and became the king who sang to God. His son Solomon raised a temple of gold in Jerusalem, and the kingdom reached its glory.

scenes.title: THE BROKEN KINGDOM
scenes.say: Chapter six. The broken kingdom. The nation split in two. Kings turned to idols. But the prophets would not be silent. Elijah called down fire from heaven. Isaiah foretold a coming savior. And still, Assyria's armies swept the north away.

scenes.title: EXILE
scenes.say: Chapter seven. Exile. Babylon's fire consumed Jerusalem. The temple fell. The people were dragged into a foreign land. Yet in the lions' den, Daniel did not bow. And in the furnace, three young men walked unburned.

scenes.title: RETURN
scenes.say: Chapter eight. Return. An empire fell, and the captives came home. Stone by stone, they rebuilt the temple. Nehemiah raised the walls. And a young queen named Esther risked everything to save her people.

scenes.title: THE SILENCE
scenes.say: Chapter nine. The silence. For four hundred years, no prophet spoke. Empires rose and fell. Greece. Then Rome. And in the darkness, a people waited for the promised one.

scenes.title: THE LIGHT
scenes.say: Chapter ten. The light. A star appeared over Bethlehem. In a humble manger, Jesus was born. He grew, and he walked among the people. He healed the blind. He calmed the storm. He taught that the last shall be first.

scenes.title: THE CROSS
scenes.say: Chapter eleven. The cross. Betrayed with a kiss. Nailed to a cross. The sky went dark, and it was finished. But three days later, the stone was rolled away. The tomb was empty. He had risen.

scenes.title: FIRE
scenes.say: Chapter twelve. Fire. At Pentecost, the Spirit fell like tongues of flame. Fishermen became preachers. And Saul, the hunter of believers, was struck by blinding light, and became Paul, who would carry the message to the ends of the empire.

scenes.title: THE LETTERS
scenes.say: Chapter thirteen. The letters. From prison cells and distant cities, the apostles wrote. Of faith. Of grace. Of a love that is patient and kind, a love that never fails.

scenes.title: REVELATION
scenes.say: Chapter fourteen. Revelation. On a lonely island, John saw the heavens open. A final battle between light and darkness. And then, a new heaven, and a new earth, where every tear is wiped away.
From the first light, to the last dawn. Sixty six books. One story.
